title: The Mango Tree
summary: A little girl loves to hide in a big mango tree. Guess who finds her in the end?
pages: We love to visit Grandma's village.

Grandma has a big mango tree in her garden.
Lots of birds come to sit in it.

I love to hide in the tree.
Nobody can see me here.

Dad looks for me by the well.
Mom looks for me by the cowshed.
But nobody can find me.

Oh no!
In the end, Grandma's dog found me.

Now I have to climb down from the tree.
Grandma gives me a big hug.
